purpose: Fixed difficult-sequence subset for method validation, not a full dataset benchmark
selection: Two lowest F1 scenes per dataset in the already completed sampled32 baseline; selected before inspecting current candidate results
averaging: Equal-scene means within each dataset over exactly these two scenes; identical subset for every candidate and baseline
controls: Reuse existing matched per-scene complete results; no unchanged control reruns
parameter_tuning: Scene selection sets validation scope only; do not tune method parameters against 7Scenes test truth
